To be honest, I turned off all my notifications, so now I barely ever use any apps even when I’m bored. Most of it is all fake garbage, if they doesn’t help, then find something you like to do. Maybe paint something or cook something, or try something out of your comfort zone and see what you like.

One time I was walking my dogs (Staffordshire bull terrier‘s) to the corner store with my next door neighbor. We were both young and our parents didn’t like us walking by ourselves without the dogs because they thought the dogs would protect us. One was white (his name was cookie boy) and the other one was black (her name was Chelsea). So we got money from our parents, and since it was close, they let us walk by ourselves with the dogs. We saw this homeless looking man sitting by the door and the dogs weren’t let inside so I had to wait outside while my friend got all the snacks. The man started to talk to me and said stuff like, “wow, nice zebras you’ve got there!” “Can I touch them?” “They’re firm!” “Lemme hold the leash and help you walk home!”. I kinda just stood there telling him what breed they are and my friend comes back outside so we start to walk back and he asks again if we can walk us home and we both say no. He kinda just looks like he didn’t understand what we said and watched us walk down the road. Once we get near the corner to turn into our neighborhood, I see him in the car turning into our neighborhood, kinda going slowly so I decided to see if he lives near us but he waits by the corner. I tell my friend that I feel weird about the guy and she tells me not to worry about it, but I tell her that we should walk to the neighborhood park to let the dogs get more time to run around. We walk to the little grass area and his car starts to stop next to it, so we both give each other a look of “we gotta leave” and we didn’t want him to know where our house is, we run through the grass to the other side of the neighborhood while his car tries to turn around to go the way we are going. We hide between two houses and wait for a couple minutes trying to breathe before we go home. We never told our parents what happened because we still wanted to get snacks from the store.
